title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF continued to leverage its flagship; (MCCT+) programme to reach more vulnerable women and children in Sudan, including those affected by the ongoing conflict. Despite high volatility and insecurity, UNICEF successfully reached an additional 45,000 women in Kassala, Red Sea and River Nile states.;
